snippet.title: Walmart Just Changed How Prices Work. Most Shoppers Have No Idea.
snippet.description:
Walmart is putting digital price tags in every U.S. store by the end of 2026. These electronic shelf labels let prices change from a computer, any time of day. So I tested them myself. I compared the shelf tag, the register, and the Walmart app on the same items in central Maryland to see if the prices actually match.

Before you shop this week, here's what I found, what the law allows, and how to protect your grocery budget.

WHAT I FOUND
• 9 of 10 items matched across the shelf tag, the register, and online
• Bread rang up at $1.52 against a $1.48 shelf tag
• Whole sections of blank digital tags showing only an ID number and no price
• No price trackers on the carts at my stores
• My total by the tags: $52.07. My total at the register: $52.11 (before tax)
• I checked online prices as a guest, without logging in, and online orders can add fees the shelf doesn't show

WHAT YOU'LL LEARN
• What Walmart's digital price tags (electronic shelf labels, or ESLs) actually are and who makes them
• The difference between dynamic pricing, surge pricing, and personalized "surveillance" pricing
• Why retailers want your shopping data, and where I think the line should be
• What Maryland's new pricing law bans, and what it still allows
• What to do if the register charges more than the shelf tag
• A simple checklist to make sure you pay the price on the tag

CHAPTERS
0:00 I compared Walmart's shelf tags to the register
0:45 Why shoppers don't trust the new price tags
3:00 What Walmart's digital price tags can actually do
6:00 Do digital price tags even get the math right?
8:45 Smart carts, shelf cameras, and a heart-rate patent
12:30 Dynamic vs. surge vs. surveillance pricing explained
16:30 Maryland's new law: what's banned and what's still legal
18:00 The receipt: shelf price vs. register price
21:00 How to make sure you pay the price on the tag
23:00 My honest verdict

QUICK ANSWERS
Does Walmart use digital price tags? Yes. Walmart had them in about 2,300 stores by early 2026 and plans to have them in every U.S. store by the end of 2026.

Can Walmart change prices during the day? Yes. Digital tags can be updated remotely, and in most states nothing requires a store to hold a price for the day.

Does Walmart charge different people different prices? Walmart says it prices "the product, not the person." In this video I show what I could and couldn't verify, and why it's worth watching anyway.

What if the register charges more than the shelf? In most states, including Maryland, the shelf price matters. Ask for a price check at the register or customer service, and report repeat problems to your state's weights and measures office.

SOURCES REFERENCED
Walmart CEO John Furner's public letter on pricing • Maryland HB 895 (Protection From Predatory Pricing Act, effective Oct. 1, 2026) • VusionGroup (formerly SES-imagotag) investor filings • UC San Diego study on electronic shelf labels and surge pricing • Consumer study of Instacart prices across 437 shoppers

snippet.title: What It Really Means to Be “Nagging” 👇
snippet.description:
What It Really Means to Be “Nagging” 👇

She wished she didn’t have to keep reminding him all the time.

He wished she wasn’t always on his case.

But beneath the frustration and sharp words…

There’s a deeper truth unfolding.

He blurts out something raw:

“I love you.”

Not just words, but a powerful admission wrapped in emotion.

Because sometimes what feels like nagging is really love trying to be heard.

A love that’s fierce, protective, and patient, even when it’s hard to see.

👉 Sometimes criticism is just a clumsy way of showing care.

👉 Love often comes disguised in the everyday struggles and conflicts.

👉 Recognizing love beneath frustration changes how we respond.

The uncomfortable truth?

We often mistake care for annoyance, and distance ourselves from the very people who want the best for us.

So the real question is:

How much love are we missing because we don’t listen past the noise? 👇💬

snippet.description:
Leyla’nın anlatacakları Teoman’ı korkutuyor. AİLECEK GERÇEKLERİ KONUŞACAĞIZ
Daha 17 | 26. Bölümü izlemek için tıklayın: https://youtu.be/GUp9S1iyl7M

(22 Kasım 2026)

Bağ evindeki yangından kurtulan Aras, Leyla ve Teoman hastaneye kaldırılır. Leyla, Teoman’ın aslında Demir olduğunu öğrenmenin sarsıntısını yaşar. Gerçeği saklayan ailesine ve Aras’a duyduğu güven sarsılır. Teoman’a her şeyi anlatmak üzereyken Aras’la hesaplaşır. Barış’ın yaşam savaşı arkadaşlarını bir araya getirir.

Aras ile Teoman hem yangının hem de saldırının arkasındaki Caner’in peşine düşer. Ancak Hakan’ın kurduğu yeni tuzak iki kardeşi ölümle burun buruna getirir. Teoman’ın eline geçen telefon, babasının sakladığı hangi gerçeği açığa çıkaracaktır? Hakan’ın oyunu kardeşlerin kaderini nasıl değiştirecektir?

Yurtlarda büyüyen 17 yaşındaki Aras’ın geçmişine ve ailesine ulaşma çabasını merkezine alan Daha On Yedi, İstanbul’da başlayıp Bodrum’a uzanan sürükleyici bir hikaye sunuyor.

What began as an ordinary fishing trip quickly turned into a heartwarming act of kindness.

This touching rescue is a reminder that even a small act of compassion can make a tremendous difference in an animal's life.

Sometimes, the greatest reward for helping wildlife is simply watching it return to where it belongs! ❤️

snippet.title: Felipe González responde a Bono tras pedirle que reconsidere su voto: "Él lo hace pro bono" #29N
snippet.description:
El choque político entre los referentes históricos del PSOE se ha intensificado este lunes en plena recta final de la campaña electoral. El expresidente del Gobierno Felipe González ha respondido de forma contundente a las declaraciones del exministro de Defensa y expresidente de Castilla-La Mancha, José Bono, quien le había instado públicamente a no hacer "el tonto" y a respaldar la candidatura de Pedro Sánchez recordando que "el PSOE te debe mucho a ti, pero tú más al PSOE". 

A su llegada al campus pacense de la Universidad de Extremadura, donde participa en unas jornadas sobre Transición Política y Archivos Personales junto al expresidente extremeño Juan Carlos Rodríguez Ibarra, González ha reaccionado con ironía a las palabras de su compañero de filas declarando ante los periodistas: "No sabe cómo se lo agradezco. Yo sé que él lo hace 'pro bono'. Por tanto, no hay ningún problema. Se lo agradezco muchísimo".

snippet.title: Warum diesem Läufer der Sieg sofort aberkannt wurde 😳
snippet.description:
#shorts #sport
▶️Als dieser Läufer als Zweiter über die Ziellinie kam, drehte er sich plötzlich zu seinem Gegner um, der als Erster ins Ziel gekommen war, zeigte auf ihn und schrie, dass er geschummelt hat. In dem Moment verstand niemand, was da überhaupt los war. Alle dachten, er sucht nur eine Ausrede für seine Niederlage – und ahnten nicht, dass er vollkommen recht hatte. Zu Beginn des Rennens, kurz nach dem Start, lief für diesen Läufer noch alles super, und er hielt das ganze Rennen über problemlos ein stabiles Tempo. Doch ein paar Sekunden vor dem Ziel passierte etwas Merkwürdiges zwischen den beiden Läufern. Die Kampfrichter beschlossen daraufhin, sich die Szene genau anzuschauen, um rauszufinden, was kurz vor dem Ziel wirklich passiert war. Nachdem sie sich die Aufnahmen der letzten Sekunden mehrmals angesehen hatten, kapierten sie endlich, warum der Zweitplatzierte so reagiert hatte – und trafen eine Entscheidung, die alle überraschte. Sie erklärten, dass der Führende im Zielsprint seine Hand genutzt hatte, um den Zweitplatzierten zu blockieren – damit der nicht vorbeizieht, als er auf den letzten Metern noch mal anzog. Nach den Wettkampfregeln gilt es als schwerer Regelverstoß, einen Gegner auf diese Weise zu behindern. Deshalb erkannten die Kampfrichter dem Läufer sofort den Sieg und den Punkt ab und sprachen beides dem Läufer zu, der eigentlich als Zweiter ins Ziel kam. Findest du diese Entscheidung fair?
